description: The policy that decides which part of a conversation each model call sees: full buffer, sliding window, running summary or a hybrid.
Send only the most recent messages that fit a budget. Flat cost, but everything older is forgotten.
A model-written summary of the older part of a conversation, updated incrementally and sent instead of the messages it replaces.
The maximum tokens a call may spend on conversation context, measured with a token counter rather than a message count.
The messages that no longer fit the window. They are folded into the summary, and only after that succeeds are they dropped from the stored history.
Answer quality degrading as the context grows long and noisy, well before the context window is full.
Details lost or distorted when a summary is rewritten many times. Folding each message exactly once limits it.
Replacing older context with a shorter representation (usually a summary). Some providers and frameworks now do it automatically.
